jobPostingInfo.title: Senior Coordinator, OT SCADA
jobPostingInfo.jobDescription:
Worker Type: Employee

Job Post End Date: 11/28/2026

About this opportunity:

Reporting to the Manager OT Operations, the Senior Coordinator, OT SCADA provides senior-level technical coordination, governance, and multi-site accountability for SCADA systems and Observation Well (OBS) monitoring and control infrastructure across Upstream Thermal and Conventional facilities.  This role ensures front line operations support, standards compliance, data integrity, risk management, and MOC/project execution alignment for SCADA and OBS assets while acting as the primary interface between Operations, Engineering, Reservoir/Subsurface, Projects, and external integrators.


This role can be located out of our Calgary or Lloydminster office.


What you’ll do:

  • Lead coordination of the SCADA systems and Observation Well (OBS) operations, ensuring safe, reliable, and consistent support across Thermal and Conventional assets.
  • Manage SCADA work intake, prioritization, scheduling, and execution of operational support, maintenance activities, projects, and MOC requests.
  • Coordinate SCADA and OBS infrastructure activities including new well additions, shut-ins, telemetry systems, alarm management, and data quality.
  • Oversee the annual Integrated Winter Program (IWP), including planning, budgeting, installation, commissioning, and delivery of OBS and SCADA-related projects.
  • Ensure integrity, availability, and lifecycle management of SCADA and OBS systems, including hardware/software inventories, upgrades, cybersecurity compliance, and capital renewal planning.
  • Coordinate incident reporting, disaster recovery readiness, after-hours support, corrective actions, and business continuity processes.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, system records, and data standards, ensuring compliance with operational, measurement, and reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Projects, Cybersecurity, and external contractors to support commissioning, outages, turnarounds, and operational reliability.
  • Provide team leadership through resource planning, technical oversight, mentoring, performance management, training, onboarding, competency development, and continuous improvement of standards and processes.

Who you are:

Our ideal candidate will have the following minimum requirements:

  • Legally authorized to work in Canada.
  • Registered P.Eng, Technologist or Red Seal Technician designation.
  • Minimum 12 years related industry experience with demonstrated leadership.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of SCADA architecture, RTU/PLC integration, telemetry/industrial communications, system lifecycle management, and Observation Well instrumentation and data acquisition.
    • Experience with one or more SCADA/telemetry platforms.
    • Experience with RTUs, PLCs and field controllers.
    • Familiarity with industrial communication protocols and telemetry.
    • Understanding of OT cybersecurity, remote access governance, and SCADA data integrity/historian management.
  • Strong understanding of Management of Change (MOC) processes, alarm management strategies, preventative maintenance and with system lifecycle and obsolescence monitoring.

We acknowledge the value of transferrable skills and may consider equivalent combinations of experience and education should you not meet a specific requirement.


As this position has been identified as safety sensitive, employment of a final candidate selected for this position will be conditional upon successful completion of required pre-employment medical and alcohol/drug assessments.


For this position you will be required to maintain a Class 5 driver's license, a satisfactory driving record, and adhere to the appropriate Company policies and guidelines.  A driver's abstract will be one of the background checks requested in the pre-employment screening for the final candidate.

Note: The application deadline for this position is 11:59 PM MT November 27, 2026.

Who we are:


Ranked as one of Canada’s Best Employers in 2025, Cenovus is an integrated energy company headquartered in Calgary. We’re committed to maximizing value by developing our assets in a safe, responsible and cost-efficient manner. We operate in Canada, the United States and the Asia Pacific region. Our operations include oil sands projects in northern Alberta, thermal and conventional crude oil and natural gas projects across Western Canada, crude oil production offshore Newfoundland and Labrador and natural gas and liquids production offshore China and Indonesia. Cenovus’s downstream operations include upgrading, refining and marketing operations in Canada and the United States.
